title: Textile
description: Textile - Fabric performance pack with no QoL features
body:
**Textile**:

**Textile** is a streamlined performance suite for Fabric, designed with one focus: maximum frame rates. No QoL mods, Textile ensures your game is _lightweight and fast_.

**Textile** is built for players who want the fastest Minecraft experience without changing the look or feel of the game.

  **Vulkan Rendering**: Harness the power of the Vulkan API for modern, efficient graphics processing that leaves OpenGL behind. (**VulkanMod**)

  **General Optimization**: Advanced refinements to pathfinding, tick logic, and engine data to eliminate stutters and lag spikes. (**lithium**)

  **No QoL**: No new menus, no extra buttons, just pure speed.
